Shesim Apartament 1+1 tek Komuna Parisit .
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5 te nje godine 11 kateshe .
Organizohet nga korridori i cili ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes se bashku me kuzhinen , dhoma gjumit dhe tualeti .
Vlen per tu theksuar investimi i sapo bere ne apartamnet i punimeve elektrike, hidraulike, tavane te varur, parket etj .
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet ofron nje jetese teper komode me te gjithe facilitetet e nevojshme per banim ose investim .
Per me teper informacion, ju lutemi na kontaktoni!!! bot125737
title_en: APARTMENT 1+1 FOR SALE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PARIS
description_en: We are selling a 1+1 apartment in the Municipality of Paris. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of an 11-story building. It is organized by the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen, bedroom and toilet. It is worth noting the recent investment in the apartments for electrical, plumbing, suspended ceilings, parquet, etc. The area in which it is located offers a very comfortable lifestyle with all the necessary facilities for housing or investment. For more information, please contact us!!! bot125737
